bank.q: Consider the following statements about the President's constrained powers:
s: The 42nd Amendment made ministerial advice binding.
The 44th Amendment allows one reconsideration, after which the President must act.
Article 61 impeachment has been successfully used once.
bank.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Article 61 has never been successfully invoked — indeed never even completed.

bank.q: Match List I (power) with List II (article):
pairs: D. Cap on the Council of Ministers
bank.e: Ordinances under Article 123, pardons under Article 72, assent under Article 111, and the ministry cap through the 91st Amendment.

bank.q: Which one of the following statements is NOT correct?
o: An ordinance cannot amend the Constitution
Article 161 does not extend to death sentences
A Money Bill may be returned by the President for reconsideration
Re-promulgation of ordinances was called a fraud on the Constitution
bank.e: A Money Bill cannot be returned. Article 111 permits return only of other Bills.

bank.as: The executive in India exercises substantial legislative power.
bank.rs: It legislates by ordinance under Article 123 and through delegated legislation, both inherited or expanded from colonial practice.
bank.e: Both true and the Reason explains the Assertion. India, Pakistan and Bangladesh are the only parliamentary democracies retaining ordinance power.

bank.q: Consider the following statements about accountability of ministers:
s: Collective responsibility is expressly provided in Article 75(3).
Individual responsibility is a weaker convention in India than in the United Kingdom.
India has a codified Ministerial Code equivalent to the British one.
bank.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. India has no ministerial code — the Second ARC recommended one and it remains unimplemented.

bank.q: Which of the following correctly pairs a case with its holding?
o: Maru Ram — the pardon power is personal discretion
D. C. Wadhwa — re-promulgation is a fraud on the Constitution
Shatrughan Chauhan — clemency is beyond judicial review
Bimolangshu Roy — Parliamentary Secretary posts are valid
bank.e: Maru Ram held clemency must follow ministerial advice, Shatrughan Chauhan allowed commutation for delay, and Bimolangshu Roy struck the posts down.

bank.q: All of the following are reserve or discretionary powers of the President EXCEPT:
o: Appointing a Prime Minister in a hung Lok Sabha
Dismissing a government that has demonstrably lost its majority
Refusing to promulgate an ordinance recommended by the Cabinet on policy grounds
bank.e: The President may seek clarification and return advice once, but there is no recognised discretionary power to veto an ordinance on policy grounds.

bank.q: Arrange the following in correct chronological order:
items: Krishna Kumar Singh settles the re-promulgation question
bank.e: The 44th Amendment (1978) → D. C. Wadhwa (1987) → the 91st Amendment (2003) → Krishna Kumar Singh (2017).

bank.q: With reference to the Vice-President, consider the following:
s: The office is first in the line of presidential succession.
State legislators participate in the election.
The casting vote in the Rajya Sabha has rarely been used.
bank.e: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Only members of Parliament vote — a standing criticism given that the office chairs the Council of States.

bank.as: Delegated legislation and the ordinance power raise the same underlying constitutional concern.
bank.rs: In both, law-making passes from the elected chamber to the executive, with scrutiny reduced or postponed.
bank.e: Both true and the Reason explains the Assertion — which is why the essential-functions doctrine and the urgency requirement play parallel limiting roles.
